definitions.explanation: A small mesh strainer used to filter tea leaves when pouring brewed tea. Sometimes built into the spout of a {急須|きゅうす} (Japanese teapot).

examples.japanese: {茶葉|ちゃば}が{湯飲|ゆの}みに{入|はい}らないよう、{茶漉|ちゃこ}しでこした。
examples.english: I strained the tea so no leaves would get into the cup.

examples.japanese: この{急須|きゅうす}は{茶漉|ちゃこ}しが{内蔵|ないぞう}されているので{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: This teapot is convenient because the strainer is built into it.

notes:
Compound of {茶|ちゃ} (tea) + {漉|こ}し (the noun form of {漉|こ}す, "to strain"). Refers to either a handheld strainer or one built into a teapot.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶漉|ちゃこ}しを{使|つか}う: to use a tea strainer
- {茶漉|ちゃこ}しでこす: to strain with a tea strainer
- {茶漉|ちゃこ}し{付|つ}き{急須|きゅうす}: teapot with a built-in strainer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {急須|きゅうす}: Japanese teapot — often has a {茶漉|ちゃこ}し built into the spout
- ティーストレーナー: tea strainer (loanword) — same thing, used more in Western-style tea contexts
- ざる: mesh basket strainer — for food, not tea
